<b>Worried Pilgrim</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are one of the few hardy pilgrims to have reached [[the Citadel]], found resting near the [[wishwall]] in [[Songclave]] in [[Act 3]].

== In-game Events ==
Hornet can meet the Worried Pilgrim in Songclave after obtaining [[Silk Soar]] during Act 3, if the [[Second Sentinel]] was awakened. They tell Hornet that their life was saved by the Second Sentinel, referring to them as a "golden knight", and express admiration for their bravery.

Once their dialogue has been exhausted, they have a 25% chance of being gone the next time Hornet reenters the room after resting elsewhere. Once they have left, they remain absent for the rest of the game.

{{TabbedDialogue
|Title1 = General
|Title1_Event1 = First encounter
|Title1_Dialogue1 = Sister, you seen 'em out there? Our new champion, that golden knight stalking the Citadel's crumbling halls?<br>
Tall, righteous bug. Not much for conversing. Still! I'd be long dead if not for their appearance.<br>
And I ain't the only one. Others have spoken of the knight's timely deeds and rare bravery.<br>
We're desperate for any protection we can get, and that gleaming champion's been offering their aid almost as much as you yourself.
|Title1_Event2 = Exhausted dialogue

== Location ==
Worried Pilgrim can be found east of the wishwall in [[Songclave]] in [[Act 3]], if the [[Second Sentinel]] was awakened.
